body:
This is an account report of Etizolam experience.
I'm a 22 years old guy relatively in good health except my skinny body size.
I am prone to anxiety and panic attacks so I have a lot of experiences by taking benzodiazepines such as Alprazolam (which I'm prescribed for Anxiety Disorder).
I bought 100 Etizolam pellets from a reliable source and I was curious about his effects.
Being cautious and due to my low weight I proceed to cut the blue pill (they are not the Etilaam one but home made) in half.
I can't really give you a timelapse, sorry about that.
00:00 I chewed half a pill of Etizolam which is 0.5mg
+20min : Lightheadness noted and I'm feeling warm waves in my body, it's getting very pleasurable and make me very chilly already! This is indeed a strong anxiolytic (and also more sedative than Alprazolam which I'm used too).
+30min : I decided to redrop 0.5mg (Total 1mg now).
The other half start hitting me in 15 - 20 min. The 'high' is getting clearly stronger. I'm overwhelmed by a strong euphoria and I'm laughing for no apparent reasons.
Etizolam gives a very nice, serein and peaceful feeling. The dose I took (1mg now) reminds me a lot of 2mg Xanax/Alprazolam but more sedative, that's maybe the only downside from Etizolam.
The lightheadness is stronger and my body feels warm, I'm really in a happy mood and the sedative effect of Etizolam make me want to sleep!
I changed my clothes and go to bed, the effects are still going strong.
I put my headphones with some relaxing music (ATB - Ecstasy EmireJ Chill Summer Remix) and within minutes I fall asleep!
I had a really good sleep which I haven't had for a while! Thanks to Etizolam.
I think this benzo could be very addictive because I was hesitating to take another pill but I told myself not since benzo withdrawals are no jokes!
The next day, I can still feel residual effect from the pill. I'm just happy and content and most important anxiety-free!
I'm very happy to have tried this benzo and next time I will take 1mg at once.
I may purchase more in the future since it seems to have REAL medecinal values and I can easily see Etizolam replacing my Alprazolam prescription.
Thank you for reading my report and sorry for my english, but I'm not a native speaker!
Take care and happy research!
